name: KeepCart
summary: Shopify app against coupon leaks: tracks where your discount codes show up, locks a code to a protected link and, on paid plans, blocks coupon extensions at checkout.
best_for: Shopify stores that run discount codes and want to see where they leak and lock a code to a protected link
skip_if: you rarely run public discount codes, or you need proof that the coupon blocker works before you pay
honest_knock: We could not test the part most stores pay for, the coupon blocker, because the paid plan showed a real $49 charge with no test note. The free plan gives one scan a month and no blocking. A non Plus store was offered only Blocking Basic. The app asks for sensitive customer data at install, and the protected link needs a theme extension that we did not switch on.

sessions.what: Our AI assistant ran the test on 21 November 2026 on a Shopify development store, with the interface in English. We installed KeepCart, stayed on the free plan and made a protected link for a 10% test code. We did not approve the paid plan and did not place an order.
findings: Install: the permission screen lists customer data (sensitive data, device and activity data), staff data and store data (customers, orders, discounts, store analytics, Online Store).

Protected link: about two minutes after install, on the free plan, a protected link for our test code TESTLEAK10 (10%) showed as Active. The app created the discount itself. The link needs the theme extension switched on, and we did not switch it on.
Free plan: one coupon leak scan a month, no coupon blocker. The first scan was still running when we stopped, and the app said it could take 10 to 20 minutes.

Paid plan: a non Plus store was offered only Blocking Basic at $49 a month with a 30 day trial. The Shopify approval screen showed $49.00 due on 21 December and no note that it was a test charge, so we did not approve it.
Cancelling that screen gave the message 'The shop cannot accept the provided charge', and the app then offered 'Continue with free plan', which we took.
not_tested: whether a leaked code is really refused when it is used outside the protected link
the coupon blocker for browser extensions, leak alerts and code removal, which belong to the paid plans
the Plus only plans Starter, Growth, Pro and Max
